title: BlockThat
description: Block other players to run commands that you don't want them to run.
body:
**BlockThat** is a lightweight yet powerful Minecraft plugin designed to give server admins total control over which commands players can use. This plugin allows you to block any specified commands from being executed by players.

## **Key Features:**
- **Customizable Command Blocking**: Block specific commands entirely or restrict them to certain players.
- **Granular Control**: Apply restrictions globally or for specific users, groups, or permission levels.
- **Easy-to-Use Configurations**: Effortlessly set up the plugin with an intuitive configuration file.
- **Command Logging**: Keep track of blocked command attempts to monitor player behavior and enhance security.
- **Permissions Integration**: Seamlessly integrate with existing permissions plugins for advanced command restrictions.
- **Lightweight and Optimized**: Minimal performance impact on your server, even with a large number of players.

## **Permission**:
- blockthat.view: Allow players to use the commands anyways.

The plugin can be used on any 1.21+ version and it can be modified through the config.yml file which is located at /BlockThat/config.yml
